notes: ZIP is zip32; 5969 central-directory entries, 123 of them lib/**/*.so
All 123 .so entries use compression method 0 (stored): compressed==uncompressed and the file bytes are contiguous inside the APK, so in-place mmap is possible
data_offset = local_header_offset + 30 + name_len + extra_len, with both lengths read from the LOCAL file header (not from the central directory)
e_machine codes used here: AArch64=0xB7, ARM=0x28, x86-64=0x3E, i386=0x03
every .so is e_type=ET_DYN (shared object / PIE-style); no ET_EXEC was found

directory name is NOT the architecture: lib/armeabi-v7a/libnesec-x86.so and lib/armeabi/libnesec-x86.so are EM_386, lib/arm64-v8a/libnesec-x86.so is x86-64, and lib/{armeabi,armeabi-v7a}/libxmediaplayer_x.so are EM_386 inside ARM directories
symbol file offset is derived from PT_LOAD: file_off = p_offset + (st_value - p_vaddr) with p_vaddr <= st_value < p_vaddr+p_filesz; apk_offset = zip_data_offset + file_off

symbol 'version' comes from .gnu.version plus .gnu.version_r/.gnu.version_d; index 1 with the base flag is the file's base version node, whose name equals the SONAME, so a value like 'libssl.so' means base/unversioned and NOT an OPENSSL_* node. These libssl.so images define no OPENSSL_* version node at all
libmsaoaidsec.so (both ABIs) keeps only 4 section headers (NULL, 2x STRTAB, DYNAMIC) - the packer stripped its symbol table, so symbols are returned as null as required
several .so files are byte-identical across ABI directories (same build-id), e.g. lib/armeabi/libnesec.so == lib/armeabi-v7a/libnesec.so
the 'x86' key in abi_counts holds 32-bit i386 files; 'other' is empty here

DT_NEEDED chain: libssl.so needs libcrypto.so; the only other consumer is libswsport.so (all 3 ABIs), which declares NEEDED libssl.so + libcrypto.so but imports only EVP_* from libcrypto and no SSL_* symbol, and contains dlopen/dlsym literals
